# sbm-cli command reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_skill_reference.py from sbm-cli 0.6.0. Do not edit by hand. -->

`--help` output of every command in sbm-cli 0.6.0. If `sbm --version` reports a different
version, trust `sbm <command> --help` on the installed CLI over this file.

## `sbm`

```text
Usage: sbm [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  SBM 12.0 JSON API command-line client.

Options:
  --version      Show the version and exit.
  -H, --pretty   Human-readable output
  --config PATH  Override config file location
  --quiet        Suppress stderr status messages
  --indent       Output formatted JSON with indentation
  --help         Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  auth          Credential commands.
  configure     Setup commands — write the config file (see --config / SBM_CLI_CONFIG).
  field-values  Discover valid values for a relational field.
  fields        List field definitions by inspecting a sample ticket.
  get           Get a ticket by display ID (e.g.
  list          List tickets from one or more reports (merged, de-duplicated) or a filter.
  schema        Print machine-readable capabilities JSON.
  teams         List configured teams from [teams] config section.
  transition    Run a named transition or a raw transition by ID.
```

## `sbm auth`

```text
Usage: sbm auth [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Credential commands.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  check  Verify that the resolved credentials authenticate against the SBM host.
```

## `sbm auth check`

```text
Usage: sbm auth check [OPTIONS]

  Verify that the resolved credentials authenticate against the SBM host.

  Reports which source the password came from, never the password itself. Useful as a one-shot smoke
  test after 'sbm configure import' on a headless machine.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm configure`

```text
Usage: sbm configure [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Setup commands — write the config file (see --config / SBM_CLI_CONFIG).

  With no subcommand, runs the full setup wizard (same as 'configure setup').

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  export      Print the current config as TOML on stdout, for copying to another machine.
  import      Install a config from PATH, or from stdin when PATH is '-' (the default).
  setup       Full interactive wizard — configures connection, defaults, and list fields.
  transition  Add or update a named transition in the config file.
```

## `sbm configure export`

```text
Usage: sbm configure export [OPTIONS]

  Print the current config as TOML on stdout, for copying to another machine.

  The output never contains a password — Config has no password field. Redirect it to a file: sbm
  configure export > sbm-config.toml

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm configure import`

```text
Usage: sbm configure import [OPTIONS] [SOURCE]

  Install a config from PATH, or from stdin when PATH is '-' (the default).

  Validates before installing, so a malformed import never touches an existing config. Does not
  contact the SBM host — run 'sbm auth check' for that.

Options:
  --force  Overwrite an existing config file
  --help   Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm configure setup`

```text
Usage: sbm configure setup [OPTIONS]

  Full interactive wizard — configures connection, defaults, and list fields.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm configure transition`

```text
Usage: sbm configure transition [OPTIONS] NAME

  Add or update a named transition in the config file.

  Example: sbm configure transition assign

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm field-values`

```text
Usage: sbm field-values [OPTIONS] FIELD_NAME

  Discover valid values for a relational field.

  Probes the field's source table by ID range using 10 concurrent requests. Find the table ID in
  'sbm get <ticket-id>' output under relTableId.

  Example: sbm field-values ROOT_CAUSE --table 9999

Options:
  --table INTEGER      Table ID for the relational field (find in 'sbm get' field metadata as
                       relTableId)  [required]
  --max-probe INTEGER  Max item IDs to probe  [default: 500]
  --help               Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm fields`

```text
Usage: sbm fields [OPTIONS] TICKET_ID

  List field definitions by inspecting a sample ticket.

  Fetches TICKET_ID and reports all field dbnames, inferred types, and labels. Uses the configured
  table_id by default; override with --table.

  To discover fields that are null on this ticket, pass them explicitly:

    sbm fields 02440942 --fields FUNCTIONALITY,APPLICATION1,COUNTRY_IM

  Example: sbm fields 02440942

Options:
  --table INTEGER  Table ID (defaults to configured table_id)
  --fields TEXT    Comma-separated field dbnames to probe explicitly (for fields absent from this
                   ticket due to null values)
  --help           Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm get`

```text
Usage: sbm get [OPTIONS] TICKET_ID

  Get a ticket by display ID (e.g. 02440942).

Options:
  --fields TEXT  Comma-separated field dbnames (default: all)
  --help         Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm list`

```text
Usage: sbm list [OPTIONS]

  List tickets from one or more reports (merged, de-duplicated) or a filter.

Options:
  --report INTEGER  Report ID (repeatable; overrides configured report_ids)
  --filter TEXT     Filter ID or name
  --fields TEXT     Comma-separated field dbnames (default:
                    TITLE,STATE,OWNER,SECONDARYOWNER,URGENCY,SEVERITY)
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```

## `sbm transition`

```text
Usage: sbm transition [OPTIONS] NAME TICKET_ID

  Run a named transition or a raw transition by ID.

  Named:  sbm transition assign 02440942 --field OWNER=316 Raw:    sbm transition run 02440942 --id
  155 --field OWNER=316

Options:
  --id INTEGER       Transition ID (required when NAME is 'run')
  --field KEY=VALUE  Field value to set (repeatable)
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```
